note: PUBLISHED COPY, from core's config/fi/outdoor-fit.json. Do not edit here: change core's canonical and re-publish this copy. core's check (config/fi/check-published-copy.sh) runs on every core PR and daily, and fails core's required job if this copy and core's own rows differ. web-app's check (scripts/check-outdoor-fit.mjs) runs its own dayOutdoorFit over these rows, so moving a threshold on one side alone fails the other's CI. The rows are the contract rather than the four thresholds, because core folds web's two `if` lines into one branch: only the answers can be compared, and rows also pin which branch runs first. This repo hosts the copy because it is the one public repo every consumer's CI can read token-free. JAR-2828.
